title: Prevent overflow while clipping finite MLX gradients
author: sylvesterkaczmarek

data.description: Fixes gradient clipping to square float32 gradients in float64 to prevent overflow during norm computation while preserving existing clipping behavior

novel_contributions: Prevents overflow in MLX gradient clipping for large but finite gradients
Performs the square operation in float64 to match intended accumulation precision
Preserves threshold, denominator offset, tensor dtypes, tree structure, and disabled-clipping behavior
